biography.plain_text: Pieter S. Samara is a Dutch businessman from the Schoonheim coal-trading family. He continued his father's Arbitcoal business as an investment company and later led international asset-management businesses from Bangkok. Alongside his commercial career, he became a Kundalini yoga teacher and published instructional writing under the name Pieter Schoonheim Samara.

long_biography.plain_text:
Pieter Schoonheim Samara developed a body of writing for Kundalini yoga teachers, initially distributing the articles as training handouts. The collection covered breathing, daily practice and the relationship between active exercise and stillness. His approach drew on study with Yogi Bhajan and combined practical instruction with an interest in Advaita philosophy.

In his instructions, Samara emphasized attention to posture without forcing a perfect position or straining the body. He encouraged students to extend the duration of exercises gradually and treated the quiet period after movement as an integral part of practice. His teaching materials circulated online as a sequence intended to be read and revisited alongside regular practice.
